questions.instruction_text: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

question_data.text: What made David leave London and move to Northsea?
options: A. He was eager to develop a hobby.
B. He wanted to work shorter hours.
C. He found his job in website design unsatisfying.

questions.explanation: David explains that he was keen on boats and moved to pursue this interest/hobby in his free time.

questions.instruction_text: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

question_data.text: The Lifeboat Institution in Northsea was built with money provided by
options: A. a local organisation.
B. a local resident.
C. the local council.

questions.explanation: Funds were provided by a generous member of the public (a local resident) who lived there all her life.

questions.instruction_text: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

question_data.text: In his health assessment, the doctor was concerned about the fact that David
options: A. might be colour blind.
B. was rather short-sighted.
C. had undergone eye surgery.

questions.explanation: The doctors were concerned he might be colour blind, but it turned out he was fine.

B. what equipment it will be necessary to take
C. if the lifeboat should be launched

questions.explanation: The helmsman has the ultimate authority to decide if the boat should launch in a given scenario.

D. The casualty care activities were particularly challenging for him.
E. The wave tank activities provided practice in survival techniques.

questions.explanation: David notes the exercises built mental strength/confidence, and the wave tank provided survival technique practice.

options: A. they no longer fit.
B. she no longer likes them.
C. they are no longer in fashion.

questions.explanation: Bella recycles shoes that are in perfect condition simply because she gets tired of them.

options: A. More shoes are bought than are thrown away.
B. Less footwear is recycled now than in the past.
C. The manufacturing process uses less recycled material.

questions.explanation: Don was confused that footwear recycling rates dropped to 6 percent despite rising sales.

questions.instruction_text: What was the reason why the manager at the recycling centre rejected each of the following shoes? Choose FOUR answers from the box.

question_data.text: High-heeled shoes
options: A. One shoe was missing.
B. The colour of one shoe had faded.
C. One shoe had a hole in it.
D. The shoes were too dirty.
E. The heels of the shoes were worn.
F. The stitching on the shoes was broken.
G. The shoes had the wrong size label.
H. The lining of the shoes was torn.

questions.explanation: The manager rejected the high-heeled shoes because their heels were badly worn.

questions.instruction_text: What was the reason why the manager at the recycling centre rejected each of the following shoes? Choose FOUR answers from the box.

question_data.text: Ankle boots
options: A. One shoe was missing.
B. The colour of one shoe had faded.
C. One shoe had a hole in it.
D. The shoes were too dirty.
E. The heels of the shoes were worn.
F. The stitching on the shoes was broken.
G. The shoes had the wrong size label.
H. The lining of the shoes was torn.

questions.explanation: The ankle boots were rejected because one had faded in color due to sun exposure.

question_data.text: Tardigrades are also known as water 'bears' (due to how they [blank]) and 'moss piglets'.

questions.explanation: Tardigrades are called water bears because they move with a slow, bear-like walk.

questions.explanation: Tardigrades have a short, plump body with four pairs of legs.

questions.explanation: Tardigrades utilize either sharp claws or suction discs to grip surfaces.

questions.explanation: Instead of respiratory systems, they use a body liquid carrying blood and oxygen.

question_data.text: Mouth shaped like a [blank] with teeth called stylets.

questions.explanation: Their mouth is shaped like a small, hollow tube containing stylets to pierce food.

questions.instruction_text: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

questions.instruction_text: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

question_data.text: Cryptobiosis: A type of [blank] ensures their DNA is not damaged.

questions.explanation: Tardigrades express a unique protective protein that shields their DNA.

questions.instruction_text: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

question_data.text: Cryptobiosis: Research is underway to find out how many days they can stay alive in [blank].

questions.explanation: Scientific experiments tested how many days they can survive in the vacuum of space.

questions.instruction_text: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

question_data.text: Feeding: Consume liquids, e.g., those found in moss or [blank].

questions.explanation: Tardigrades feed on fluids, such as those extracted from moss or seaweed.

question_data.text: Conservation status: They are not considered to be [blank].

questions.explanation: Tardigrades are highly abundant and are not considered endangered.
